question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/761e010a79f7bac9c0ef22f57acb59e39e5e4cb0b7cc7bf398bd51c0633e05b9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I:- The lines moves to: AC, AD, & AE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f20c3d14ddd2b5cc0577a980f2283d12bcc4e9cb01c763934703f0dd9893c64a.png] 

Step II:- The lines moves to BD, BE, & BF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/935faeafe24f7084ad0715471dd0ead40dfeeca343bba20a28da99d763fb61ef.png] 

So, the series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b18d6ada4918fa0ac919e1468e3c2194a8cde6c65785e6cf28e93c226db9bf1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
